# Lemon Squeezy Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads your Lemon Squeezy store: list orders, subscriptions, customers and products, and create checkout links (confirmed first). Honest note: creating a checkout link makes a real payment link — the skill confirms product, variant and price with you before creating one. Reads move no money. No secrets in the repo — API key stays in Muse's secure vault.
